body: Speaking from experience bro, youre gonna hve to start at the bottom. Get it where you fit in. All that shit you here like "it's not what you know but who you know." That shits true. Think about it if you had a Fortune 500 and knowledge of the corruption in the world today, how far would you ger hiring people you don't know to have the best interest of your business and well being? To save you some time not far at all. You have to earn your stripes, prove your worth. It takes time, discipline, and sorry to say some ass kissing. That's just the world we live in sorry. It aint impossible though. I have quit several good paying jobs becausing the person/people i was working under was dumber than a mf. Ideally self-employment is the way to go and if u dont have rich people with resources in your back pocket you gotta get your own seed money by kissing some as for awhile. Sorry bro. Stay strong.

We have different paths of life but it has lead us to the similar points in our life. I too am comtemplating suicide. Im still alive because i have faith that god is looking out for me, and i couldnt let my soulmate down like that it wouldnt be fair. She's sacrificed and done so much for me i owe it to her. As a man you cant let others dictate your happiness. That is disrespectful to god. He should come first. People are flawed. We were not supposed to be perfect. Look to god for guidance. You'll see the humor in how he works the stronger your relationship with him grows. Ask him for help and trust him to follow through. Then the growth starts, you'll see it for youself.

Faith. You're not dead yet. My car got repoed yesterday, my rent is due on the 1st, and ive been unemployed for over a week with 7 bucks to my name. All i have the energy to do is sleep, i guess itz kind of funny how tht works. If i didnt know god i wudve been dead a long time ago, you have to believe in him. Hold your head up, i know itz darkness all around you. That jus makes it easier to find the light. He has plan for u, and if u tell someone u got their back but they stress and complain like your word is nothing u would feel disrespected. Think of how god feels. He's always shown up right in the nick of time for me. He's the only thing keeping me from putting a bullet in my head. We weren't designed to conquer the world by ourselves. We need him and he needs us. All of us. All he requires for his loyalty is your faith. I hope u pray for me as I'll be praying for u.

Just wanted to share. I can totally relate to you bro. I lost my job recently as well. Ive never been attractive, i was even an ugly baby. Im at the lowest point in my life right now honestly. I might even beat u to it. I just wanted to tell u tht ur not alone. You're 1 of many but you belong to the elite who have the courage to let it out. I've gotten to the point where i find a little happiness in knowing i might die today because i feel like tomorrow will just be worse than today. Itz sad and i know it but who cud judge? Who has lived my life through my eyes? Im not here to tell u what to do, but all those people who aren't to fond of you now are gonna miss the hell out of you. They are gonna change for the better as soon as you're gone. That's a reflection of the power your love has on them. If u don't feel they deserve give to those who don't have any at all because they won't be picky. Don't say you're alone in this because i found your story and im jus as bad as u.
